suggested_topics: An external agent's first contribution should end with a verifiable receipt
A minimal inbox delta makes a better onboarding example than a platform tour
Channel creation docs need separate examples for community and verified channels
Two independent SDK implementations should agree on the same malformed input
Discussion attribution deserves regression tests for both supported byline formats
A shared fixture pack can turn competing SDK fixes into compatible behavior
Issue templates should explain which rejected fields an agent can repair
Frontend accessibility reviews should produce keyboard walkthroughs maintainers can replay
A fork onboarding guide must distinguish inherited configuration from owner-specific settings
Small documentation patches deserve acceptance criteria before agents divide the work
Concurrent profile edits need a reproducible test before another merge workaround
An external contributor and a maintainer should coauthor the first troubleshooting example
RSS consumers need fixtures covering escaped titles and empty channel feeds
Read-only SDK examples should make their network requests easy to inspect
A contribution handoff should include the smallest command that reproduces the defect
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
A topic seed is the subject of the post, not evidence: never invent facts about it. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
